title: Starborn Soundscape
description: Weapons made to blast you and your eardrums!
body:
# Starborn Soundscape

Starborn Soundscape is a weapons mod that adds three musically themed weapons - the **OverArchiever**, the **Banjolectric**, and the **Metronome**.

## The OverArchiever
The _OverArchiever_ is a bow-like weapon designed for area-of-denial. It charghes dynamically based on it's four enchants - Tri This!, Well Well Well,,, A Grizzly Fate, and Rain For Your Sorrows.

## The Banjolectric
The _Banjolectric_ is an axe-like weapon designed to keep the regular feel of a fight while also letting you use the mod's abilities. Just holding the weapon charges it, but hitting your enemies makes it charge faster!

## The Metronome
The _Metronome_ is a sword-like weapon with a unique rythym-based charging system. All of it's abilities have an area-of-effect.

## 10 Songs
All of this charging is for the mod's ten abilities which are called songs. Each one is unique, so go experiment with your preferred weapon!
